description: ukpopulation is a Python module for obtaining and organizing UK population estimates and projections by age, sex and geography. Its developers draw on official national and subnational series from the UK statistical agencies. The JOSS paper describes local-authority estimates and variants of future projections; the own repository calls it a population and demographics projection module and reports MIT, so the software is free. Spatial coverage is the United Kingdom with local-area units where the source release supports them. Temporal coverage and resolution follow the selected official release, usually annual; old ranges quoted in the paper should not be mistaken for a current data release. Infrastructure modellers could use the age and place distribution to estimate service demand or exposure. A caveat is that official variants are conditional projections, not observed future population, and boundary changes or suppressed cells require attention. The package is a client and harmonizer, not an independently validated demographic theory. No directly related catalogue record was established. The paper and own repository were read without downloading population data.
name: ukpopulation UK demographic projections
notes: G5 G5-0843. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
